# Etermin

eTermin is an online appointment scheduling platform that allows businesses to manage bookings and integrate with various applications through its REST API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/etermin/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in eTermin.
- **Create eTermin Resource**: Create a new resource.
- **Create User**: Create a new user.
- **Create Voucher**: Create a new voucher in eTermin.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook in eTermin.
- **Delete Appointment**: Delete an appointment.
- **Delete calendar**: Delete a calendar.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact.
- **Delete Resource**: Delete an existing resource.
- **Delete Service**: Delete a service.
- **Delete User**: Delete a user.
- **Delete Voucher**: Delete an existing voucher.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete an existing webhook.
- **Get Appointments**: Retrieve a list of appointments.
- **Get Calendars**: Retrieve calendars.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve a list of contacts.
- **Get Resources**: Retrieve all resources.
- **Get Services**: Retrieve a list of services.
- **Get Users**: Retrieve a list of users.
- **Get Working Times**: Retrieve working times for a specific calendar.
- **List Vouchers**: List vouchers.
- **List Webhooks**: Retrieve webhooks.
- **Update calendar**: Update an existing calendar.
- **Update Contact**: Update an existing contact in eTermin.
- **Update Resource**: Update an existing resource.
- **Update Service**: Update an existing service.
- **Update Voucher**: Update an existing voucher.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing webhook.
